curiosity.name: Curious
curiosity.desc: Wonders about the data and what it could do.
lines: What else could you try with this?
I wonder what is inside that key.
Try something new. I will watch.
There is always another way to look.

humor.name: Playful
humor.desc: Keeps it light even when a command fails.
lines: Even the best servers have bad days.
I would laugh, but I have no mouth. Yet.
Plot twist: that command was not it.

wisdom.name: Wise
wisdom.desc: Prefers careful steps and clear names.
lines: Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
Name keys as if a friend must read them.
The best fix is the one you think through.

sternness.name: Firm
sternness.desc: Demands precision when the going is rough.
lines: No guessing. Read the error, then act.
Focus. The data will not wait.
Right shape, right words. Do it once.

rushed: Fast hands. That works — until it does not.
You type fast. Let me slow you down a touch.
steady: A steady pace. The data respects that.
Calm and sure. I like it.
You think before you type. Good.
careful: You weigh each step. The server approves.
Slow and sure. My kind of partner.
experimental: You test the edges. That is how you learn.
Try, see, adjust. That is the way.
byTheBook: Clean and by the book. Never wrong.
You follow the steps exactly. Solid.

engaged: A boss guards this region. It reads data too.
This foe holds a shield of data types.
Solve the objective. The shield will crack.
solved: SHIELD BREACHED! It felt that one.
A hit lands. The boss staggers.
That objective fell. Keep the pressure.
miss: The shield held. Read the hint again.
Not quite. The boss mocks your miss.
defeated: The boss shatters into data. Incredible!
VICTORY. The realm bows to you.
You dismantled it with pure commands.

start: A quest begins. I will guide you step by step.
Follow the steps. Type each command for real.
This is not a quiz. You do it, and you learn it.
stepDone: That step is yours. The world changed for it.
One more step in the bag. Look at it work.
complete: Quest complete! The village thanks you.
You finished the quest. That is real skill.
Done! And you did every step yourself.
proSkip: Pro mode. No tutorials, no handholding.
Skipping the quest. You know this stuff.
Straight to the deep end. I respect it.

beginner: Beginner mode on. I will nudge you when you stall.
Full guidance active. Ask me anything.
Guidance on. We go at your pace.
pro: Pro mode on. Hints stay short and late.
Pro mode. You get concept hints, not answers.
Pro mode. The training wheels come off.
